name: HYDRA-UMC-ORCHESTRATOR
notes: Established v0: real gRPC/Protobuf health-report schema, verified by actually compiling it with grpc_tools.protoc and round-tripping a real HealthReport message through serialize/parse - the shared service contract its 4 children build against. Plus a real, pure in-memory mission state machine (src/mission.rs): Mission (Pending->Dispatched->InProgress->Completed, Cancelled/Failed terminal), idempotent cancel() (cancelling an already-cancelled mission succeeds as a no-op, never errors), and recover_from_unavailable_node()/MissionRegistry::recover_node_unavailable() (requeues a Dispatched/InProgress mission to Pending when its node is reported unreachable/invalid, e.g. by HYDRA-UMC-NODE-HEALING's watchdog). 22 tests. Exposed via the `mission-demo` CLI subcommand. Real gRPC transport to JOB-DISPATCHER/NODE-HEALING remains future work - genuinely blocked on those services not having a real API to call yet.
